identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Regorafenib as a 3rd-line or Beyond Treatment for Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors (GIST)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase III Study of Regorafenib Plus Best Supportive Care Versus Placebo Plus Best Supportive Care for Subjects With Metastatic and/or Unresectable Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors (GIST) Whose Disease Has Progressed Despite Prior Treatment With at Least Imatinib and Sunitinib

armGroups.label: Regorafenib (Stivarga, BAY73-4506)
armGroups.description: Participants received Regorafenib (Stivarga) 160 mg (4 x 40 mg tablets) per os once daily, 3 weeks on therapy followed by 1 week off therapy to comprise a cycle of 4 weeks

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants received matching Placebo tablets per os once daily, 3 weeks on therapy followed by 1 week off therapy to comprise a cycle of 4 weeks

interventions.name: Regorafenib (Stivarga, BAY73-4506)
interventions.description: 160 mg po once daily (od), 3 weeks on/1 week off. Route of administration: oral

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: once daily (od), 3 weeks on/1 week off. Route of administration: oral

interventions.name: Best supportive care
interventions.description: Best supportive care includes any method to preserve the comfort and dignity of the patients, and excludes any disease-specific anti-neoplastic therapy such as any kinase inhibitor, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or surgical intervention.
